articles.title: Hightouch Raises $150 Million to Reinvent How Marketing Works Using AI
articles.mainIdea: Hightouch Raises $150 Million to Reinvent How Marketing Works Using AI
articles.summary: Business Wire: Hightouch Raises $150 Million to Reinvent How Marketing Works Using AI. SAN FRANCISCO, April 29, 2026--Hightouch, the leader in data and AI for marketing, today announced a $150 million Series D financing led by Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives and Bain Capital Ventures, valuing the company at $2.75 billion. Additional investors and strategic partners also participated in the round, including Iconiq Capital, Sapphire Ventures, Amplify Partners, Y-Combinator, and TD7, the venture capital arm of The Trade Desk.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs and Bain Lead Investment in AI Marketing Startup
articles.mainIdea: Goldman Sachs and Bain Lead Investment in AI Marketing Startup
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Goldman Sachs and Bain Lead Investment in AI Marketing Startup. Hightouch, a platform that uses generative AI to help marketers create and manage campaigns, has raised a $150 million funding round led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives’ Growth Equity division and Bain Capital Ventures, the companies said. The round, which also included TD7, the venture capital arm of adtech firm the Trade Desk, values Hightouch at $2.75 billion. The company’s most recent funding round valued it at $1.2 billion in February 2025.
